strings.name: Elon Musk
strings.role: Entrepreneur · Commercial spaceflight and electric vehicles
strings.summary: From online payments to electric vehicles and commercial spaceflight, Musk has helped establish and develop several technology companies. He founded SpaceX, invested in and led Tesla, and advanced the commercialization of reusable rockets and electric cars. Acquiring Twitter brought him into social-platform governance. His management methods and public statements have long attracted controversy, and his securities disclosures have also led to regulatory penalties.
strings.coverageNote: Selected life and career milestones from 1971 to 2023. The verification date does not mean that the chronology covers all subsequent activities.

strings.highlights.highlight-01.title: Commercial spaceflight
strings.highlights.highlight-01.text: Founded SpaceX, whose Crew Dragon spacecraft first carried NASA astronauts to the International Space Station in 2020.
strings.highlights.highlight-02.title: Commercializing electric vehicles
strings.highlights.highlight-02.text: Participated in Tesla’s early financing and led the company as its range expanded from the Roadster to the Model S, Model 3 and other vehicles.
strings.highlights.highlight-03.title: Reusable rockets
strings.highlights.highlight-03.text: In 2017, SpaceX launched a previously flown Falcon 9 first stage for the first time.
strings.timeline.event-01.title: Founds xAI; Twitter becomes X
strings.timeline.event-01.text: Announced the AI company xAI; that same month, renamed the previously acquired Twitter brand as X.
strings.timeline.event-02.title: Completes Twitter acquisition
strings.timeline.event-02.text: Completed the acquisition for about US$44 billion, extending his business interests further into social media.
strings.timeline.event-03.title: SpaceX’s first crewed launch
strings.timeline.event-03.text: The Demo-2 mission launched two NASA astronauts, marking an important milestone in commercial human spaceflight.
strings.timeline.event-04.title: Settles with the US SEC
strings.timeline.event-04.text: Settled allegations concerning tweets about taking Tesla private and stepped down as chairman. He and Tesla each paid a US$20 million penalty.
strings.timeline.event-05.title: Turning points for Tesla and SpaceX
strings.timeline.event-05.text: Became Tesla’s chief executive; the Roadster was released and Falcon 1 reached orbit in the same year.
strings.timeline.event-06.title: Participates in Tesla’s early financing
strings.timeline.event-06.text: Led the first investment round and became chairman, later becoming deeply involved in electric vehicle products and the company’s development.
strings.timeline.event-07.title: Founds SpaceX
strings.timeline.event-07.text: Established the commercial spaceflight company. PayPal was acquired by eBay that year, providing capital for his subsequent ventures.
strings.timeline.event-08.title: Moves from Zip2 to online payments
strings.timeline.event-08.text: After Zip2 was acquired, helped establish the online financial-services company X.com, which developed into PayPal following a merger.
strings.timeline.event-09.title: Co-founds Zip2
strings.timeline.event-09.text: Developed online city guides with his partners, beginning his internet entrepreneurship career.
strings.timeline.event-10.title: Born in Pretoria
strings.timeline.event-10.text: Born in South Africa; later studied in Canada and the United States, including economics and physics at the University of Pennsylvania.
